list: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list, 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (official names, descriptions and grades)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN progress counts, e.g. 42 Shooting Range challenges)
Guide notes: written for this guide from the official descriptions; specific in-game steps are not yet verified in play, as the game released 19 Nov 2026
note: Names, descriptions and grades below are exactly as PlayStation publishes them. The guide, steps and flags are this guide's own words, built from those descriptions.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to chase. Treat it as the finish line of the roadmap: story first, then side strands and activities, then collectibles and the long grinds last. It cannot be missed — it pops automatically once everything else is done.
steps: Earn every other trophy on this list.
Work through the roadmap in order so the long grinds (250 stunts, 100 WAiNK spots) run in the background of normal play.
Check the tracker: when it reads 54 of 54, the platinum is yours.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end. It is the game's first mission, so it unlocks in the opening minutes and cannot be skipped past. If the trophy does not pop, finish the mission's final objective rather than quitting out early — quitting mid-mission is the only way to delay it.
steps: Start a new game and follow the opening mission prompts.
Complete every objective of Gone Fishing until the mission-complete screen appears.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies are story progress, not skill checks: keep playing the gold story markers and this pops when the chapter's last mission ends. There is no way to miss it by playing the story through.
steps: Play the Chapter 1 story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it is pure story progress: follow the story markers, and it unlocks when the chapter closes. Side content can wait — the chapter trophy only cares that the story missions are done.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. By this point the story opens up across Leonida, so it is worth clearing side strands you pass on the way, but the trophy itself only needs the chapter's story missions completed.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. This is the last numbered chapter, so once it is done only the final mission stands between you and the gold story trophy. Do any remaining partner or stranger missions you want before the finale, since the endgame is a natural point to start the cleanup phase.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the game's final mission. It is a gold trophy because it marks the end of the story, not because it is hard to find — it appears once Chapters 1 to 4 are done. Before starting it, finish any story-adjacent content you care about (partner missions, stranger strands), because post-story Leonida is for cleanup, not for new story.
steps: Complete Chapters 1 to 4.
Play and finish the final mission.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named-mission trophies like this one unlock by finishing that mission, whenever it appears in the story. Play the story in order and it will come to you; there is no separate trigger to hunt for.
steps: Follow the story until Breakfast Run appears.
Complete the mission.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are usually longer and multi-stage, so stock up on ammo and armour before starting, and play the setup beats carefully rather than rushing. The trophy pops on mission completion, not on any single objective inside it.
steps: Follow the story until The Cartel Heist appears.
Complete the mission, including its escape or aftermath objectives.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. The name suggests a family thread in the story, so expect it mid-story rather than in the opening. As with every named-mission trophy, finishing the mission is the whole requirement.
steps: Follow the story until Child's Play appears.
Complete the mission.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The trophy name hints at a big public moment in the story. Play it as the story presents it — no preparation beyond the usual mission loadout is needed, and the trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen.
steps: Follow the story until Headliners appears.
Complete the mission.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Airport missions tend to be loud and heavily policed, so expect a wanted level on the way out and plan your escape route before the final objective, not during it.
steps: Follow the story until VCIA Takedown appears.
Complete the mission and escape the airport area.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The name points to a large-scale operation, likely late in the story, so come prepared for a long fight. The trophy is for completion only — it does not ask for a medal or a time, so play it safe rather than fast.
steps: Follow the story until Operation Savage Glory appears.
Complete the mission.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% in the game's completion checklist. This is the second gold trophy and the real long game: it counts story missions, side strands, activities and collectibles together, so it is effectively the platinum minus the odd one-off trophies. Use the in-game stats screen to find which category is still short, and finish the grinds (stunts, WAiNK spots, meditation spots) last, when you can route them efficiently.
steps: Finish the story and all side strands.
Complete every activity and collectible category the stats screen lists.
Check the completion percentage after each category until it reads 100%.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, airtime and similar driving feats — across Leonida. The count is cumulative, so every stunt you do while driving normally adds up; do not grind it in one sitting. Use fast cars on highways and ramps, and let it build naturally during story and side missions, then mop up the remainder with repeated jumps at a spot you like.
steps: Drive fast and take jumps and ramps whenever you travel.
Watch the stunt counter in the stats screen.
Grind the remainder at a reliable jump once the rest of the game is done.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — PSN progress count (250)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once. This is a sampler trophy: it rewards breadth, not mastery. Work through the activities the game offers — racing, fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest — doing one of each. The tracker lists them; tick each type off as you try it so none is forgotten.
steps: Open the activities list in the game and note the 9 types.
Do one session of each type.
Check the trophy pops once the ninth type is tried.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: each challenge has a score threshold for gold, so learn the weapon and the target pattern before pushing for the top medal. Start with the weapon types you are best with, use cover and steady aim rather than spraying, and replay a challenge immediately while its layout is fresh in mind.
steps: Visit a shooting range and work through the challenges weapon by weapon.
Learn each challenge's gold score, then replay until gold.
Finish all 42 — the trophy needs gold in every one, not just most.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — PSN progress count (42 challenges)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you need a win everywhere, not 14 wins at one spot. Learn each course's corners before racing flat out — a clean line beats a fast crash — and note which locations you have already won so you do not repeat them.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
Win the race at each location.
Track the locations won in the tracker until all 14 are done.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — PSN progress count (14 locations)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word different matters: winning the same race 20 times does not count, so spread your wins across the race list. Pick a fast, grippy car for road races and learn the starts — most races are won or lost in the first corners — then work through the list one new race at a time.
steps: Open the race list and pick races you have not won yet.
Win each one.
Keep going until 20 different races are won.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are usually scored on the size or number of fish caught in a set time, so focus on quick, clean catches rather than chasing the biggest fish. Watch Cal's score if the game shows it, and use the best rod and bait you have unlocked before challenging him.
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge.
Fish the challenge with your best gear.
Outscore Cal before the time runs out.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full playthrough or reach its end, depending on the machine. Arcade games are short, so try a couple of cabinets and pick the one whose rules you understand fastest. This is one of the easiest trophies on the list and a good early win.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Play one game through to its end.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's strand of side missions. Contact strands unlock over the story, so keep checking for Andy's missions as the story progresses and do each one when it appears, rather than leaving the whole strand for the endgame. The trophy pops when his last mission is done.
steps: Take Andy's missions whenever they appear.
Complete each one in order until his final mission is done.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's strand. The boat-accident name suggests his missions involve the water, so expect boat chases or waterfront jobs. As with every contact strand, do his missions as they appear during the story so the strand is finished by the time you reach the finale.
steps: Take Kenton's missions whenever they appear.
Complete each one in order until his final mission is done.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's strand. The lone-rider name points to bike work, so keep a good motorcycle handy for his missions. Finish his strand before the endgame cleanup so his missions do not get lost among the collectible grinds.
steps: Take Billy's missions whenever they appear.
Complete each one in order until his final mission is done.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map — talk to them, take their first mission, and follow each strand to its end; a strand only counts when its last mission is done. There are more than 8 strangers in the state, so you can skip a strand you dislike and still reach the total.
steps: Find stranger markers across Leonida and start their missions.
Finish each strand completely.
Complete 8 strands in total.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — PSN progress count (8 strands)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's strand. The supply-and-demand name suggests runs and deliveries, so expect timed driving or transport jobs. Do his missions when they appear in the story and the strand will finish naturally.
steps: Take Randy's missions whenever they appear.
Complete each one in order until his final mission is done.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's strand. Take his missions as they unlock during the story and finish each one before moving on; leaving a strand half-done is how side trophies get forgotten until the endgame.
steps: Take Tyrone's missions whenever they appear.
Complete each one in order until his final mission is done.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places — hilltops, beaches and viewpoints — so they are easy to miss if you only drive the highways. Explore each region on foot once you are nearby for another trophy, meditate at every spot you find, and keep a count so the last few are not a blind hunt.
steps: Visit scenic spots across Leonida and look for the meditation prompt.
Meditate at each spot you find.
Keep count until all 18 are done.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — PSN progress count (18 spots)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Unique-animal hunts are usually a tracking job: follow the clues or the trail Bret gives you, move quietly, and take the shot only when it is clean — a spooked animal can waste the whole attempt. Bring a scoped rifle and approach from downwind if the game models it.
steps: Take Bret's hunting job.
Track the unique animal to its location.
Hunt it and return to Bret.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, interiors and hidden spots — and a set only counts when every card in it is found. Collect cards whenever you pass a likely spot rather than saving them all for the end, and track which sets are one card short so your final hunt is targeted.
steps: Pick up collectible cards wherever you find them.
Check which sets are nearly complete.
Finish 3 full sets.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — PSN progress count (3 sets)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. This is the longest collectible grind on the list, so start early and do it a few spots at a time whenever you travel — never make a dedicated 100-stop trip at the end if you can help it. The count needs different locations, so revisiting the same spot does not help.
steps: Use WAiNK It at new locations as you travel.
Watch the counter in the stats screen.
Sweep the remaining regions for unvisited spots at the end.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — PSN progress count (100)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small goals — driving feats, combat feats, exploration goals — and they tick over during normal play. Check the challenge list regularly and pick off the easy ones (short drives, simple takedowns) alongside your other trophies; the total builds faster than it looks.
steps: Open the challenge list and note the easy ones.
Complete challenges during normal play.
Mop up the remainder deliberately until 50 are done.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — PSN progress count (50)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. The tricky part is the setup: your partner must be with you when the wanted level is lost, so do it during a partner mission or a free-roam session together, not solo. Get the heat in open country where you can break line of sight, then hide until the stars clear — do not try it in a dead-end alley.
steps: Have your partner with you in free roam or a mission.
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — the run must stay hot the whole time. Plan a route of three close shops before you start, keep a fast getaway car parked outside each one, and do not stop to fight: the wanted level must survive all three robberies, so speed matters more than the take from any single shop. If the wanted level drops, the chain breaks and you start over.
steps: Pick three shops close together and park a fast car nearby.
Rob the first shop with your partner, keeping the wanted level.
Rob the second and third immediately, without losing the wanted level.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new vehicle you get into counts, so variety is the goal: try cars, bikes, trucks, boats and anything else you see parked or driving, in every district. City streets give you the common models fast; the rare ones hide in wealthy areas, industrial yards and the countryside.
steps: Get into every new vehicle type you see.
Visit different districts for different models.
Check the discovered count until it reaches 100.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — PSN progress count (100)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. You need five targets close together, so do not try this on scattered enemies — pick a firefight with a group, wait until they cluster, then trigger Combat Focus and work through them quickly with headshots. If the focus ends before the fifth takedown, the attempt fails and you try again in the next big fight.
steps: Find a fight with at least 5 enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus when they are clustered.
Take down 5 of them before the focus ends.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, take off in a plane without going through the normal channels. Get a plane on the VCIA runway, build speed and lift off; the trophy is about the departure itself, so expect police attention and be ready to fly away fast once you are airborne.
steps: Go to VCIA and get to a plane.
Take the plane onto a runway.
Take off — an unscheduled departure.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This trophy is about the Rhino tanks — the description is a joke about how hot it gets inside them. In practice it means engaging with Rhinos: steal one, drive one, or survive an encounter with one at a high wanted level. Rhinos appear when the heat is at its highest, so build a big wanted level in open ground, then deal with the tank that arrives.
steps: Build a high wanted level until a Rhino tank is sent after you.
Engage with the Rhino — steal it or survive it.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. This is a stealth run: go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt is over — leave, lose any heat, and try again. Plan the store first: watch the staff pattern from outside before you go in.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and watch its staff and cameras.
Enter quietly and take the goods without being seen.
Leave without triggering an alarm or detection.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape from each one. Each vault is its own job: get in, crack or open the vault, grab the cash and get out clean. The escape is part of the trophy, so plan your getaway before the robbery — a fast car nearby and a route out of the area matter as much as the vault itself. The five do not need to be in a row.
steps: Find a bank with a robbable vault.
Rob the vault and escape.
Repeat for 5 different vaults.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — PSN progress count (5)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida, so watch for one on the road, block it or force it to stop, take the cash and get away before the police box you in. The escape counts: do not celebrate at the truck — leave the area fast.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it and take the cash.
Escape the police response.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you visit each named area, so this is a travel trophy: drive, fly and sail to every corner of the state, including the small towns and the countryside far from Vice City. Use the map to spot the blank patches and route a trip through them.
steps: Open the map and note which areas are still blank.
Travel through every unvisited area.
Keep going until all 52 areas are explored.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — PSN progress count (52 areas)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own operations somewhere in Leonida, so this is a tour of the criminal map: find one operation per gang, hit it, and move on. Keep a list of which gangs you have hit — the ninth is easy to forget when the first eight blur together.
steps: Find an illegal operation run by a gang.
Rob it.
Repeat for all 9 gangs, tracking which are done.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — PSN progress count (9 gangs)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a quiet moment trophy: go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or spot with a view of the water, and order a cocktail. It is one of the easiest trophies on the list — do it early, when you first reach the beach, and enjoy the view.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a bar with a view of the water.
Order and enjoy a cocktail.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, get a car inside or line one up outside, and go through it at speed. Expect an alarm and police, so have your escape planned before you hit the glass.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom with a glass front.
Drive a car through the showroom and out the front.
Escape the police response.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — the follow-through in the description means actually bowling, not just walking in. Go to the alley, start a game, and bowl through it. Bowling is also one of the activity types for the Master of None sampler, so this trophy and that one can be ticked off in the same visit.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a bowling game and play it through.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — the vague description means this trophy is tied to a specific story or partner beat that PlayStation keeps hidden until it pops. Play the story with your partner, take the partnership moments the game offers, and this will unlock when you reach the right one. It is hidden on purpose, so do not hunt for it: keep playing and it comes to you.
steps: Play the story and partner missions as they come.
Take the partnership moments the game offers.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count toward 500, so this is about the sheer number of decisions you make across the game. Every choice in missions, dialogue and side content adds up, so play naturally and make decisions whenever the game offers them instead of skipping past them. The missable flag here is a warning: choices are the one thing you cannot go back and remake in a single playthrough, so do not rush past decision points.
steps: Make choices whenever the game offers them, in missions and dialogue.
Keep playing — the count builds across the whole game.
Watch the PSN count toward 500.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — PSN progress count (500)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — this trophy pops when you succeed at something on your second attempt after failing the first. The exact trigger is hidden, but the shape is clear: fail once, then succeed at the same thing right after. Do not be afraid of failing a mission or challenge once; the retry is part of the game, and this trophy rewards it.
steps: Attempt a mission or challenge and fail it once.
Retry it immediately and succeed.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description is deliberately vague, and this is the game's oddity trophy: a weird event or encounter somewhere in Leonida. Strange events usually happen in remote places or at odd hours, so explore the countryside, the swamps and the quiet corners at night, and this will pop when you stumble into the right moment.
steps: Explore remote and unusual places in Leonida, including at night.
Investigate anything strange you come across.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock people over with a melee drive-by — hit pedestrians with a melee weapon while driving past. This needs a slow drive through a crowded area with a melee weapon equipped, so pick a busy street, drive slowly, and swing as you pass. It is a one-attempt trick: line it up, do it, and move on before the police arrive.
steps: Equip a melee weapon.
Drive slowly through a crowded area.
Strike pedestrians with the melee weapon as you drive by.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — trophy list

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts turn them into clean cash — the total is cumulative across the whole game, so keep laundering every marked bill you earn instead of letting them pile up. Big heists move the total fastest.
steps: Earn marked bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts.
Keep going until $250,000 is laundered in total.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative and counts every shop in Leonida — clothes, weapons, food, cars and more — so it builds naturally as you gear up for missions. Do not grind it by buying junk: buy the weapons, armour and vehicles you actually need, and the total will reach $100,000 on its own by the late game.
steps: Buy weapons, armour, clothes and vehicles as you need them.
Spend across different shop types.
Check the total until it reaches $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from property listings around Leonida, and each one gives you somewhere to store vehicles — useful in itself, not just a trophy. Save up through the story, then buy the remaining garages in one sweep once you have the cash.
steps: Find garage properties for sale around Leonida.
Buy each one as you can afford it.
Own all 8 garages.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you get a new vehicle, open the Scooter Bros app and register it — the habit is the whole trophy. Ten different vehicles is a small number once you are collecting cars, so register as you go and this pops early in the cleanup phase.
steps: Get a vehicle you have not registered yet.
Open the Scooter Bros app and register it.
Repeat for 10 vehicles.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
